definitions.gloss: permanent; standing; regular; always set up
definitions.explanation: Describes facilities, exhibitions, or organizations that exist on a permanent or ongoing basis, as opposed to temporary ones.

examples.japanese: {常設|じょうせつ}⟦{展示|てんじ}→展示：12401_tenji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I went to see the permanent exhibition.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{施設|しせつ}→施設：02503_shisetsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{常設|じょうせつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦カフェ→カフェ：06767_kafe⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: This facility has a permanent cafe.

examples.japanese: {常設|じょうせつ}⟦{委員会|いいんかい}→委員会：12234_iinkai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{設置|せっち}→設置：09750_secchi⟧⟦され→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦{定期的|ていきてき}→定期的：06173_teikiteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{開|ひら}かれている→開く：01979_hiraku⟧。
examples.english: A standing committee was established and meetings are held regularly.

notes:
USAGE:
Used as a noun or as a no-adjective modifier ({常設|じょうせつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧). Also used as a suru verb in the sense of establishing something permanently ({常設|じょうせつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {常設|じょうせつ}⟦{展示|てんじ}→展示：12401_tenji⟧ (permanent exhibition)
- {常設|じょうせつ}⟦{委員会|いいんかい}→委員会：12234_iinkai⟧ (standing committee)
- {常設|じょうせつ}⟦{店舗|てんぽ}→店舗：12481_tenpo⟧ (permanent shop)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{臨時|りんじ}→臨時：04092_rinji⟧: temporary, ad hoc — the opposite concept
- ⟦{仮設|かせつ}→仮設：21123_kasetsu⟧: temporary, provisional — used for temporary structures
